objective: Calculate the sequence currents and residual current for a single-line-to-ground fault using sequence-network impedances.

title.ru: REL-TASK-034 — Расчёт однофазного замыкания на землю методом симметричных составляющих

objective.en: Calculate the sequence currents and residual current for a single-line-to-ground fault using sequence-network impedances.
objective.ru: Рассчитать токи прямой, обратной и нулевой последовательности, а также остаточный ток при однофазном замыкании на землю по сопротивлениям последовательностей.

instructions.en: Use the public per-unit sequence impedances. For an A-phase-to-ground fault with prefault voltage 1.0 pu, compute I1=I2=I0=1/(Z1+Z2+Z0+3Zf). Convert per-unit currents to kA using Ibase=Sbase/(sqrt(3)*Vbase), then report sequence current magnitudes/angles and fault current 3*I0.
instructions.ru: Используйте открытые сопротивления последовательностей в относительных единицах. Для замыкания фазы A на землю при предаварийном напряжении 1,0 о.е. вычислите I1=I2=I0=1/(Z1+Z2+Z0+3Zf). Переведите токи из о.е. в кА через Iб=Sб/(sqrt(3)*Uб), затем укажите модули и углы токов последовательностей и ток повреждения 3*I0.

submission_schema.sequence_currents_ka: object with i1, i2, i0; each contains mag_ka and angle_deg
submission_schema.fault_current_ka: object with mag_ka and angle_deg for 3*I0

hard_constraints: Submission must contain sequence_currents_ka.i1/i2/i0 with mag_ka and angle_deg fields.
Submission must contain fault_current_ka.mag_ka, fault_current_ka.angle_deg, and residual_current_mag_ka.
The values must match the independent sequence-network calculation within tolerance.
Unknown extra answer keys are infeasible.

metrics.name: feasible
metrics.description: Whether the sequence and residual currents satisfy all hard constraints.

source_evidence: primary:Anderson, Analysis of Faulted Power Systems (Wiley-IEEE Press, 1995): symmetrical-components / single-line-to-ground fault analysis

source_provenance.locator: Symmetrical components; single-line-to-ground fault sequence and residual current derivation
source_provenance.notes: Standard symmetrical-components method for single-line-to-ground fault currents; the executable case is a compact instance. Equivalent worked examples appear in standard relay-protection texts.
